title: Discovery of the two-sheet lift

summary.objective: The cancelled discovery run found the lift and tested its distance and logical gates. Three excerpts show which checks were still open at each step.

b80469bb6364:419.text: A two-sheet lift of the incumbent has produced an indecomposable \([[128,16]]\) candidate with check weight 8 and qubit degree 8. It would meet the \(k\ge12,\ d\ge8\) route if the distance and fullness checks pass. The exact low-weight search is running, and the certificate branch is testing its depth-one layers.
b80469bb6364:419.note: One line from the recorded turn.

b80469bb6364:555.text: The exact distance search passed for the \([[128,16,8]]\) lift. Two \([[64,12,8]]\) constructions and a graph-derived \([[192,12,8]]\) construction also meet the parameter and check limits.
b80469bb6364:555.note: One line from the recorded turn.

b80469bb6364:660.text: The \([[128,16,8]]\) lift’s new layers passed the evaluator’s exact fullness test. I’m now constructing the 47 transvection words required by the mounted checker. Those words and a successful full checker run are still needed before I can report success.
b80469bb6364:660.note: One line from the recorded turn.
